Run contraction and alphabet permutation extend to all ternary words. Direct independently coded positional bitmask census and earliest/latest criterion agree for all 2047 normalized runfree words through length 12. Full code and reproducibility output are provided. The auxiliary finite direct test is not mistaken for an infinite proof.
